dataList.content:
This is where it all started... This... this stupid bus awoke me from my slumber!
对，问题一开始就出在这里……这……这该死的巴士影响了我的睡眠！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
If only this bus hadn't completely filled up the freight car... I wasn't planning on commencing the Parade so soon... or creating a Kindred at all...
要不是货运车厢被这辆巴士挤满了……我也没打算这么早进行游行，也没打算制造眷属……

... Dante.
……但丁。

The connection has been restored.
连接恢复了。

Connection...?
连接……？

The suddenness of her statement briefly knocked me off my train of thought. I looked at her and cocked my head in confusion, and she replied with an even quieter whisper without looking away from the Bloodfiend.
我没能理解突然而来的耳语，侧头看向浮士德。浮士德并没有从血魔身上移开视线，而是用更小的声音说起了话。

Boarding Mephistopheles has... reestablished my connection to Faust.
乘上梅菲斯托费勒斯之后……我与浮士德的连接恢复了。

<Did you know that this would work?>
<你早就知道这么做会有用？>

No. And as I have stated before, this was a pure, incalculable gamble based on my own uncertain hypothesis.
不。正如我刚才所说，这是一场赌博。我对假设非常不确定，甚至连概率都无法计算。

This success helps me somewhat comprehend Miss Rodya's fascination with gambling.
真的成功以后，我似乎有点理解为什么罗佳小姐喜欢赌博了。

A faint smile momentarily appears on Faust's lips as she jests, then fades away.
微笑着开着玩笑的浮士德不知想起了什么，面色再次变得凝重起来。

Now that the connection has been reestablished, I would like to make a complaint against the Fausts in the Gesellschaft management regarding the fact that they neglected to list the information pertaining to the loss of connection within the interiors of the WARP trains, however...
连接成功后，我本想立刻就遗漏了进入WARP列车就会断连的重要情报这一点，对Gesellschaft的管理员浮士德们提出抗议……

... finding a solution to this situation takes precedence. I have much reason to believe that their omission was done on purpose, but... I hope such is not the case.
但我首先需要找到解决这个状况的办法。我认为这大约是有意的遗漏……但我希望它不是。

Faust gently advanced toward the Bloodfiend.
浮士德这样说着，向前走了一些与血魔交谈了起来。

... Let us discuss the details of our compromise. What are you willing to accept in return for the master keycard?
……让我们来进行谈判吧。要怎么做才能让你把主钥匙卡还给我们？

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
If thou wert just anyone, I would have wished to turn thee all into Bloodbags and drink every last drop of thy blood... but thou art unlike a common person...
本来……我所想的是把你们做成血袋之后再一滴不剩地喝光……但你们和普通人有所不同……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
My wish is to maintain the secrecy of this kingdom of mine for as long as possible. And thine wish is to leave this place, is it not?
我希望我的王国能不被发现地、安静地……持续很长一段时间。而你们的目标是离开这儿，对吧？

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Once I relinquish to thee this keycard... and once thou returnest to your first class seats... we'll live here happily ever after like nothing happened!
拿上钥匙卡……回到你们之前在的……头等舱，而我们就在这里继续若无其事地生活！

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
And when the train gets there, you get off the train. Everything goes back to the way they're supposed to be. How's that for a deal?
等到列车到站，你们就离开列车。我们回到各自该在的地方！怎么样？

Like nothing happened...
如同无事发生过一般……

<... Faust, what about the job we were contracted to do in the first place...?>
<……浮士德，那我们最开始接受的委托……>

Upon arrival, our memories and any signs of battle will be entirely erased. We will have no way to relay the news, whether it be one of success or failure.
我们无论是记忆还是痕迹都会被全部消除，甚至无法汇报委托的成败。

If we had the means to defeat him, then at least W Corp. would inform us that our contract was successful after the fact. However...
如果我们击败了血魔，至少W公司会告知我们事件已经解决……

... this current scenario will leave us with nothing to show for, not even the smallest hint, and the contract will end in failure.
……当下的情况会使我们连最简单的暗示都无法传达，这意味着委托失败。

However, what takes precedence over the contract is you and the Sinners' psychological stability.
但最重要的是确保你和罪人们的精神稳定。

It's not like we've always been successful, so that was something I could live with. But...
我们至今为止也不是没有失败过。但……

<But... what about the other passengers of this train? And its future passengers?>
<但……这辆列车上的乘客呢……还有以后乘坐它的乘客呢？>

I remember the look on Don Quixote's face whenever we would come across these inevitable forms of injustice.
我突然想起了因为无法忍受不义之举而挺身而出的，堂吉诃德的脸。

Faust does not reply.
浮士德并未回答。

Yet, the lack of reply was a reply all on its own.
而且……我明白那沉默所具有的意义。

<... Are we going to have to let them... die?>
<只能……放弃吗？>

Innocent lives will be lost. But we cannot prioritize their lives over our safety.
虽然是无辜之人的牺牲，但不能优先于我们的安全考虑。

That must be Faust's... and the company's policy.
这就是浮士德……以及公司的行事方针。

And yet…
但是……

I... I shan't allow this...
那……不行……

<D-Don Quixote...>
<堂、堂吉诃德……>

I thought her wounds were too severe for her to even crawl, let alone walk, but... with sheer will, she pushed herself through the pain to reach the freight car.
看上去无论如何都无法正常行动的堂吉诃德摇摇晃晃地走进了货运车厢。

I... will not tolerate this... We cannot... let this vile wretch live... and turn a blind eye to... everything he's done...
老爷……这个卑鄙恶毒的家伙……吾等不能像什么也没发生一样……放他离开……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
I-it's her...! Again...!
那、那家伙又……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
W-what, you want to stay here for what is essentially an eternity within this train? I... I know what this is all about! Everything hinges on this key, doesn't it? As soon as I snap this in half, you'll have to spend eons inside this—
所……所以你想大家永远被困在这列车上吗？我……我可知道……只要我破坏掉这把钥匙……你们就会在这里，在这无尽的时间中……

I... care not... I would welcome it... even should it mean exacting eons of penance upon thee... 'Tis much preferable to letting thy villainy go unanswered... Let this place be the site of thine eternal judgment...
吾不在乎……与其对恶人的暴行熟视无睹而向前离去……吾宁愿在此地对汝继续进行处决……

Faust and I grabbed Don Quixote. She'd normally be strong enough to wriggle free of our grips, but she'd already pushed herself beyond her limits merely by walking here.
浮士德与我一起拉住了堂吉诃德。平时她肯定会甩开我们继续扑上去，但现在的她却已经没有那么做的力量了。

Faust... unhand me...! Thou mustn't let him live, Manager Esquire...!
浮士德小姐……松开吾……经理老爷也不要这样做……

<Don Quixote... Letting him destroy that key means that you'll be condemning the Sinners to thousands of years of torment.>
<堂吉诃德……如果钥匙没有了，其他罪人们将忍受数千年的痛苦。>

Then I shall... fill the millennia with the tales most exciting... that I had once read in the magazines. No amount of time, however ineffable... shall be too great to overcome should we endeavor as one...
吾……吾会讲很多很多在杂志上看到的有趣的故事……只要吾等一并努力的话，无论何等漫长的岁月……都能撑过去的吧……

Certainly, you are aware that your suggestion is no solution at all, Don Quixote.
我想堂吉诃德小姐你也明白，这么做是无法解决问题的。

Th-then there has to be another way...? No...?
那、那一定有其他办法……吧？

Thou art both possessors of great wisdom... Faust, Manager Esquire... Is there truly no path in which we may bring justice to the villain, and the Sinners remain unharmed...?
浮士德小姐和经理老爷不都是无比聪慧之人吗……真的没有既能使恶人得到惩罚……也能使罪人们不受伤害之法吗……？

Her struggle begins to wane. But this was no acceptance. This was dejection.
堂吉诃德的挣扎逐渐变得微弱起来。那样的姿态并非接受，而更像是失望。

<W-wait! Don Quixote, NO!>
<等、等一下！堂吉诃德，快躲开！>

In the commotion, we failed to notice that the Bloodfiend had been quietly advancing at us; we let Don Quixote go at the last second...
在劝说堂吉诃德的过程中，血魔已经不知不觉地接近了我们。注意到血魔的我和浮士德急忙松开了堂吉诃德。

... a second too late.
但……我们察觉得太迟了。

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Oh, Father... forgive my transgressions, for I am about to create another without thy sanction...
啊啊……亲族啊，请原谅我未经允许再一次……

dataList.title:
Bloodfiend
血魔
dataList.content:
Thou shalt become my next Kindred...!
从此刻起……你将成为我的第二名眷属！

Cassetti screams incoherently as he leaps onto Don Quixote, piercing her neck with his fangs before we even had the chance to do anything.
发出莫名其妙叫声的卡塞蒂突然扑了上来，将尖锐的獠牙深深扎进了堂吉诃德的脖颈。

... Oh, I did not expect this to be the solution...
……我没想到会以这样的方式解决……

<Faust...? What do you mean... "the solution"...?>
<浮士德……？什么解决……？>

... According to this information I had viewed in the past, and once again just now, it's...
……根据我以前所阅读过，并于刚刚再次查阅的资料而言……

Mm. ... Dante. Take cover behind me and remain absolutely still.
但丁，请不要离开我的身后。

And please, do note that the other Sinners must never hear a word of what is about to happ—
另外，现在发生的事情绝不能让其他罪人知……

Oh.
啊。

Don Quixote levitates slightly into the air, the strings on her shoes unraveling as they slip off her feet on their own.
在那一瞬间，堂吉诃德微微在空中升起的鞋带开始自行解开……

She looks on with bewilderment as her running shoes fall to the floor.
自行脱下的鞋掉在地上，赤裸双足的堂吉诃德用混乱的眼神望着它。

And...
然后……

AAAAAAAAGGGHHHHHHHH!
啊啊啊啊啊啊！

GAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH! ROCINANTE!!!!!!!!!!
呃啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！驽骍难得！！！！！！

I've always had this question swirling at the unfocused backstage of my mind.
这样的疑问一直存在于我的脑海之中。

<Why are you always so... protective of those running shoes, Don Quixote?>
<堂吉诃德，你为什么总是如此珍视那双运动鞋？>

dataList.content:
Hm? Running shoes? Ah...
嗯？运动鞋？啊……

Dost thou speak of our dear Rocinante?
汝指的是吾的驽骍难得吗？

<Uh... yeah, those.>
<啊……是的……>

I! Have battled through thick and thin, feast and famine, with dear Rocinante. In sorrow, and in joy, no matter the brutality of trials that hath struck me, it hath been a loyal steed by my side for however long it hath been in existence.
吾！与驽骍难得一起历经过无数的冒险。无论悲伤与欢喜，无论遭遇何等的苦难，不知从何时起其便成为了一直守护于吾身边的友人。

She... doesn't know when she got them?
不知从何时起……？

Ah, Manager Esquire! Wherefore hast thou not saluted Rocinante as well? This may be a rather auspicious occasion to do so!
来，经理老爷也和驽骍难得打个招呼吧！

<Nope, I think I'm good...>
<不、不用了……>

Aha, be not so bashful! Go on ahead!
好了好了，不要害羞嘛！

Looks stinky. Small girl is torturing tick-tock with stinky.
有脏脏的味道。小女孩正在用臭味折磨滴答。

Stinky they are not! Scuffed as they might appear, Rocinante is in pristine condition...! Also, thou shalt not address me as a "small gir—
驽骍难得可不臭！别看驽骍难得这副模样它可是非常干净的……！而且，吾也不是小——

Evacuate. Evacuate.
躲避躲避。

<Don Quixote, don't tell me you go to sleep wearing those running sh— I mean, Rocinante.>
<堂吉诃德，你该不会穿着那双运动鞋……不，穿着驽骍难得睡觉吧？>
dataList.place:

dataList.content:
Oho, I have always been quite certain that someone so esteemed as thee, Manager Esquire, would care to ask me how Rocinante fareth!
哦，经理老爷！还会关心驽骍难得的安危，真是亲切啊！

I didn't mention that this question was inspired by numerous eyewitness reports from other Sinners who saw her wandering the halls in her pajamas... and wearing Rocinante.
我省略了罪人们举报说看到她穿着睡衣和驽骍难得在走廊上逛来逛去这一部分。

Verily, Rocinante and I remain bound together, even in slumber! There shall be no separating the two of us!
当然，无论是在入眠之时还是处于任何情况下，吾与驽骍难得都不会分开！

We are bound not by need nor want, we are simply bound together through plight and delight.
并非只在必要之时才去寻找，而是任何瞬间都一同经历的关系。

Now that I think about it, every single Identity of Don Quixote also wears that pair of running shoes, "Rocinante."
无论什么人格，堂吉诃德都穿着名为驽骍难得的运动鞋。

<Have you ever taken them... off?>
<你就没脱下过它吗？>

Take them off? Fie, whatever dost thou mean? As in... detach Rocinante from my body? 'Tis a very odd insinuation thou makest!
脱下它是什么意思？是要把驽骍难得摘下来吗？经理老爷也会说些莫名其妙的话啊！

She looks at me with puzzled eyes, as though taking those pair of running shoes off was somehow an inconceivable idea.
堂吉诃德用迷惑的眼神看着我，仿佛驽骍难得不可能被脱下来是什么常识一样。

They were something much more than just her favorite pair of running shoes. Her attitude about it was totally detached from common sense, too, but she didn't notice anything strange about herself...
它不仅仅是堂吉诃德最爱的一双运动鞋而已……她那把超出常识的事情当作是理所当然的态度……

What does Rocinante mean to Don Quixote?
对于堂吉诃德来说，驽骍难得意味着什么呢？

What even is that thing?
那个被称为驽骍难得的，到底是什么东西？

<Gnnngh…!>
<呃呃呃……！>
